---
title: "Testing Power: Linear-Ratio vs. Log-Ratio Power Attractiveness"
output: github_document
date: "2026-08-21"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(furrr)
library(digest)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
source(here::here("scripts/Network.R"))
dir.create(here::here("data"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# Two candidate power-attractiveness formulas. r_op = 0 throughout, so
# a_op = 1 and only the power term is exercised.
#   linear: a_pw_ij = 2 L( r_pw (p_j/p_i - 1) )
#   log:    a_pw_ij = 2 L( r_pw log(p_j/p_i) )     [= attractiveness_gaussian_log at r_op = 0]
attractiveness_pw_linear <- function(op_i, op_j, pow_i, pow_j, r_op, r_pw) {
  2 * exp(-0.5 * r_op^2 * (op_i - op_j)^2) * .sig(r_pw * (pow_j / pow_i - 1))
}
attractiveness_pw_log <- attractiveness_gaussian_log
```

## Model parameters

- N = 500, k = 14 (Watts-Strogatz, p_rewire = 0.05), T = 20 rounds
- r_op = 0 (isolates the power term); r_pw in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32}
- self-reliance c = 0.5, decision model = gaussian_mobius (Mobius self-vote curve)
- trust / in-group inactive; 25 seeds per r_pw value per formula

```{r run}
N_SIM           <- 500L
K_SIM           <- 14L
SIM_T           <- 20L
P_REWIRE        <- 0.05
SELF_RELIANCE_C <- 0.5
R_PW_VALS       <- c(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32)
N_SEEDS         <- 25L
N_WORKERS       <- max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1)

run_cell <- function(seed, r_pw, attractiveness_fn, formula_name) {
  res <- simulate_liquid_democracy(
    seed = seed, n_per_community = N_SIM, n_communities = 1, node_degree = K_SIM, T = SIM_T,
    r_op = 0, r_pw = r_pw, p_rewire = P_REWIRE, attractiveness_fn = attractiveness_fn,
    decision_model = "gaussian_mobius", self_reliance_c = SELF_RELIANCE_C,
    sigma_opinion = "auto", fast_path = TRUE
  )
  snaps <- res$snapshots |> dplyr::filter(round >= SIM_T - 4L)
  tibble(
    formula          = formula_name, seed = seed, r_pw = r_pw,
    delegation_rate  = mean(res$history_delegation[(SIM_T - 4L):SIM_T], na.rm = TRUE),
    lost_vote_rate   = mean(res$history_lost[(SIM_T - 4L):SIM_T],       na.rm = TRUE),
    chain_length     = mean(snaps$avg_chain_length_delegators, na.rm = TRUE),
    top5_power_share = mean(snaps$top5_power_share,            na.rm = TRUE),
    share_50pct      = mean(snaps$share_50pct,                 na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

grid <- expand_grid(seed = seq_len(N_SEEDS), r_pw = R_PW_VALS)
hash <- digest::digest(list(N_SIM, K_SIM, SIM_T, P_REWIRE, SELF_RELIANCE_C, R_PW_VALS, N_SEEDS, v = 1))
cache_file <- here::here("data/testing_power_cache.rds")

if (file.exists(cache_file) && identical(readRDS(cache_file)$hash, hash)) {
  results <- readRDS(cache_file)$data
} else {
  plan(multisession, workers = N_WORKERS)
  linear_res <- future_pmap_dfr(grid, run_cell, attractiveness_fn = attractiveness_pw_linear,
                                 formula_name = "linear: r_pw(p_j/p_i - 1)", .options = furrr_options(seed = NULL))
  log_res    <- future_pmap_dfr(grid, run_cell, attractiveness_fn = attractiveness_pw_log,
                                 formula_name = "log: r_pw log(p_j/p_i)",    .options = furrr_options(seed = NULL))
  plan(sequential)
  results <- bind_rows(linear_res, log_res)
  saveRDS(list(hash = hash, data = results), cache_file)
}
```

```{r plot, fig.height=16}
metrics <- c(delegation_rate = "Delegation rate", lost_vote_rate = "Lost-vote rate",
             chain_length = "Avg. chain length", top5_power_share = "Top-5% power share",
             share_50pct = "Agents for 50% of power")

results |>
  pivot_longer(names(metrics), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(metric = factor(metrics[metric], levels = unname(metrics))) |>
  group_by(formula, r_pw, metric) |>
  summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(r_pw, value, colour = formula)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = R_PW_VALS) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("linear: r_pw(p_j/p_i - 1)" = "firebrick3", "log: r_pw log(p_j/p_i)" = "steelblue4")) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(title = "Power-attractiveness formula comparison -- mean over 25 seeds",
       x = "r_pw (log scale)", y = NULL, colour = "a_pw formula") +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey93", colour = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "top")
```
